thoughts.title: The bubble is the brief
thoughts.body: Most people collect more signal than they can act on. The work is not more inputs. It is landing what you already have.

thoughts.title: Agents need a pad, not a personality
thoughts.body: A Grok Bot without a place to leave work is just another chat. Give it a runway and the thought survives the tab.

thoughts.title: IC habit, civilian use
thoughts.body: Write it so a stranger could brief from it in sixty seconds. If it needs you in the room, it is not a thought yet.
